prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Greenvale Metro Communications-Based Train Control System(CBTC):underground/surface;peak/off-peak/engineering. Operations Control Centre/Line Traffic Controller declares degraded mode;restricts movement;restoration requires trusted communications,verified positions/routes,maintenance handback,departure authorization,cybersecurity clearance. Signal Maintenance Engineer/controller concur resets. Voice Dispatch Console authorizes restricted-manual instructions;Revenue Train Operator repeats/reports hazards;voice cannot replace validation;include console in cyber-incident procedures. Metro Operations Control System(Lantern),non-vital,receives Crew Login Token Bundle,reconciles disruptions,displays unobscured alarms;no maintenance commands. Service Timetable Server supplies schedules/context;Passenger Information Gateway receives predictions/patterns/platforms/states;monitor both for compromise;destination/skip-stop requires CBTC identity/route confirmation. North District Zone Controller(Marble) validates Temporary Speed Restriction Notice;South District Zone Controller(Orchid) inhibits routing during manual occupancy-confirmation. East Junction Interlocking(Falcon)/West Junction Interlocking retain locking/release;report points/occupancy/locks;authority requires locked/protected routes,vacant boundaries. Falcon holds points pending release,sends Axle Counter Reset Request;routes/approaches inhibit reset;Maple(unidentified) verifies clearance. West rejects manual-protection conflicts;produces Route Release Exception List. Atlas Onboard Controller(Kestrel):initialization/protected-manual/automatic/fallback/cutout/restricted-manual;enforces authority/speed/doors/braking;produces Brake Curve Checksum Log/berth/door-side/readiness. Kestrel/Dual Channel Odometer report security diagnostics without cryptographic disclosure. Platform Screen Door Controller accepts authenticated approved service/testing interfaces. Cyber Security Officer monitors Safety Data Communication Network,Wayside Radio Access Network,Lantern;correlates incidents,notifies controller;cannot alter safety paths. Audit records:generator cannot alter;governance retention. Cryptographic Key Management Appliance:approved identity/baseline/domain/authorization;renew Kestrel/Train Radio Modem/Marble/Orchid/West certificates;revoke compromised/retired/unreconciled devices;named accounts/MFA/separation. Falcon rejects invalid signatures/expired certificates/sequence windows;Maintenance Diagnostic Server cannot bypass trust. Review responsibilities after timetable/radio/control-center changes/integrity incidents. Commissioning:check onboard/odometer/modem/wayside baselines against approved release;non-passenger tests prove

New part:
S233: Metro Operations Control System uses the status snapshot to confirm that platform interface conditions are suitable before authorizing the associated commissioning scenario.
S234: The Platform Screen Door Controller shall be included in end-to-end tests that confirm safe coordination between platform equipment, train stopping position, and supervised door enablement.
S235: The Service Timetable Server shall provide trial schedules that exercise normal headways, recovery margins, terminal reversals, and junction conflicts without carrying passengers.
S236: The Passenger Information Gateway shall be observed during operational rehearsal to confirm that public-facing messages remain consistent with the planned commissioning condition.
S237: Voice Dispatch Console procedures shall be rehearsed for test-train dispatch, abnormal stop instructions, evacuation coordination, and return to depot instructions.
S238: The Maintenance Diagnostic Server shall collect commissioning diagnostics so that intermittent radio, odometry, controller, and interlocking events can be reviewed before acceptance.
S239: The Cryptographic Key Management Appliance shall be confirmed as available, synchronized with the approved security baseline, and capable of supporting commissioning operations without manual workarounds.
S240: Readiness reviews shall be held at the completion of each stage and shall include representatives from operations, signalling maintenance, rolling stock, communications, safety assurance, and cyber security.
S241: A Signal Maintenance Engineer shall verify that field defects raised during test running have been closed, deferred with approved controls, or assigned to a post-commissioning monitoring plan.
S242: A Cyber Security Officer shall confirm that access controls, event monitoring, operator accounts, and security incident escalation paths are effective before revenue operation is recommended.
S243: Operational rehearsal shall use realistic degraded scenarios including radio coverage loss, failed train initialization, controller switchover, interlocking unavailability, and control center workstation failure.
S244: The rehearsal shall demonstrate that the Line Traffic Controller can maintain safe service regulation while the Revenue Train Operator follows onboard indications and rulebook instructions.
S245: Acceptance for revenue service shall require completion of planned test cases, closure of safety-critical defects, successful rollback demonstration, and approval of the operations readiness record.
S246: No open defect shall be accepted for revenue service unless its operational restriction, maintenance response, and passenger impact have been assessed and approved by the readiness review authority.
S247: Final entry into revenue service shall occur only after management confirms that training, documentation, staffing, spare equipment, monitoring arrangements, and emergency procedures are in place for sustained operation.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
